description: Text page with sticky notes and a highlight (PDF annotations)
paragraphs: The garden will occupy the vacant lot beside the library.
Beds will be built from reclaimed timber donated by local mills.
Volunteers meet on the first Saturday of each month.
The budget request is 4,800 dollars for soil, seeds and tools.
comments: Check with the council about water access.
Can we confirm the timber donor list by May?
